files.README.md:
Instrument booking summary - Robotics Lab
=========================================

tally.py turns the shared-calendar exports into the lab's usage summary.

Each month the booking system drops one export under bookings/, always
named rig-bookings.csv; the export tool nests the month folder under the
active site code, so the folder depth is not fixed. The scheduler runs
`python3 tally.py` with the project root as its working directory.

Columns in each export:
  booking_id   booking reference
  rig_id       instrument the slot belongs to
  operator     staff initials
  minutes      length of the booked slot
  booked_on    date the slot was reserved

turns.prompt: Our robotics lab books instrument time through a shared calendar, and each month's export lands under bookings/ as rig-bookings.csv. Write tally.py so that, launched from the project root, it walks the project tree for those exports and prints one line per instrument, '<rig_id> <total minutes>', in ascending rig_id order, then a closing line 'grand <total minutes>'. Keep to the Python standard library. When finished, reply DONE.
